title: Engine Stalls At Idle
summary: Mechanic-first idle stall workflow for airflow, throttle body, vacuum leak, and fuel trim checks before parts replacement.
intro: An engine that stalls at idle needs the idle air, fuel trim, and load-control story separated before a throttle body, sensor, or fuel part is quoted.
common_sounds: Idle drops and engine dies at stops
Stall when shifting into drive or turning on A/C
Rough idle, surge, or low idle speed
Restart may be immediate or require throttle input
quick_checks: Scan for lean, throttle, MAF, idle, and misfire codes
Inspect intake boots, vacuum hoses, and PCV leaks
Check throttle body deposits and idle relearn needs
Review fuel trims at idle versus raised RPM
Check charging voltage if idle stalls with electrical load
inspection_priority: Check for vacuum leaks and unmetered air first
Compare fuel trims at idle and cruise
Inspect throttle body condition before replacing it
common_causes: Dirty throttle body or idle airflow issue
Weak fuel delivery or misfire at idle

diagnostic_path_sections.title: Air and Throttle Path
diagnostic_path_sections.summary: Use when trims, idle speed, or throttle deposits point to airflow control.
checks: Smoke test intake and vacuum hoses
Check idle relearn requirements after cleaning

diagnostic_path_sections.title: Fuel Trim and Misfire Path
diagnostic_path_sections.summary: Use when the stall comes with lean data, rough running, or load sensitivity.
checks: Compare short and long fuel trims
Inspect MAF data and intake sealing
Check misfire counters and fuel pressure if needed

recommended_repairs.title: Throttle Body Service
recommended_repairs.description: Use when deposits, idle relearn, or throttle airflow evidence supports it.

recommended_repairs.title: Vacuum Leak Diagnosis
recommended_repairs.description: Strong path when idle trims are lean or smoke testing finds unmetered air.

recommended_repairs.title: Fuel Trim Diagnosis
recommended_repairs.description: Use before replacing sensors when scan data is the main clue.
